cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到新的實作。

cues.en: After doing quite a lot of machine learning with regression and classification in the previous tutorials, now is the time to do some machine translation.
cues.zh: 先前做了不少迴歸與分類，現在做機器翻譯。

cues.en: And AWS has a great service for that, which is, of course, Amazon Translate.
cues.zh: AWS 有很棒的服務，當然是 Amazon Translate。

cues.en: Amazon Translate, Powerful Neural Machine Translation.
cues.zh: Amazon Translate，強大的神經機器翻譯。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So, this is going to be a short and sweet tutorial because it's actually super easy to use.
cues.zh: 這堂很簡短，因為使用非常容易。

cues.en: I'll just enter a text in English and we will translate it in your favorite language.
cues.zh: 輸入英文，翻成你喜歡的語言。

cues.en: I'll probably choose French because I speak French.
cues.zh: 我可能選法文，因為我會說。

cues.en: I can check the translation.
cues.zh: 可以檢查翻譯。

cues.en: So, let's click here, Launch real-time translation.
cues.zh: 按 Launch real-time translation。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: We choose first the source language.
cues.zh: 先選來源語言。

cues.en: Automatically, it'll recognize, but if we want, we can specify, of course, English.
cues.zh: 會自動辨識，但也可指定 English。

cues.en: And the target language, and as I said, I'm gonna choose French, so that I can easily check the translation.
cues.zh: 再選目標，我選 French，方便檢查。

cues.en: French.
cues.zh: 法文。

cues.en: And here, we answer the text we wanna translate.
cues.zh: 這裡輸入要翻譯的文字。

cues.en: So, I'm gonna say, "Hello, my friends," here we go.
cues.zh: 寫 Hello, my friends。

cues.en: And then, our little signature, "Enjoy the cloud."
cues.zh: 再加招牌句 Enjoy the cloud。

cues.en: All right, and indeed the French translation is (instructor speaking French).
cues.zh: 法文翻譯是，（講師以法文說話）。

cues.en: There we go, it worked really well.
cues.zh: 好了，效果很好。

cues.en: And just know that you can also do real-time translation on documents, where same, you first choose the source language, then the target language,
cues.zh: 也可以即時翻譯文件，一樣先選來源與目標語言，

cues.en: and then you upload your document file, you specify the document type between plain text, HTML, or even Word document, and you will get the translation here of your document.
cues.zh: 上傳文件，指定 Plain text、HTML 或 Word 類型，就會得到文件譯文。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And finally, maybe remember that besides real time translation, you can also do batch translation, but really at the exam, you shouldn't get more than one question on machine translation with Amazon Translate.
cues.zh: 最後記住，除了即時，也可批次翻譯。但考試應不會有超過一題 Amazon Translate 機器翻譯。

cues.en: All right, so that's it.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: As I said, short and sweet tutorial.
cues.zh: 如前所述，很簡短。

cues.en: We're gonna move on now to the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 進下一堂實作。

cues.en: And until then, of course, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，當然，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
